findings.title: Bind the imported source closure before importing it
findings.detail: The script imports mutable checkout modules at lines 78-82, then hashes only six files at 83-91. Imported dependencies such as learning, action_scoring, precision, checkpointing, language_policy, training_exposure and the recipe provider are omitted. These hashes neither authenticate an expected revision/manifest nor prove that captured bytes supplied the imported implementations. A changed dependency can produce a different plan without changing reported source_sha256. Use an independently pinned commit/manifest and capture/verify the local import closure before import; import those captured bytes and check source stability afterward.

findings.title: Bind the acceptance decision to these exact artifacts
findings.detail: The only content requirement for the caller-pinned acceptance is job_id == 35391340. A pending/rejected or unrelated decision for that job passes this predicate. Once the independent result-review schema is available, require an affirmative decision/zero required fixes and its packet/tokenization/result pins, or make that verification an explicit separately pinned outer gate rather than treating this identity check as capacity acceptance. An acceptance SHA authenticates bytes, not their affirmative meaning.
